label: Test the shared setting by varying just one of two observed live rays (inference)
rule: Enable the ray of the first reading and leave other rays off
meaning: A feasible mixed pair cannot come from one ray, by live within-ray agreement. Across distinct rays, turning on just the first ray yields a full feasible report with the second reading off. Such a pair contradicts agreement under a single shared Boolean setting. The exclusion concerns this shared-setting model, whose settings are transmitted unchanged along each intact tail.
